FedLearn announces the release of a new training course, Quantum Technologies developed by SandboxAQ.
"FedLearn is delighted to partner with SandboxAQ to deliver our first online course in quantum science to our customers," said FedLearn Founder and Chief Executive Officer Dr. J. Keith Dunbar.
"FedLearn is delighted to partner with SandboxAQ to deliver our first online course in quantum science to our customers," said FedLearn Founder and Chief Executive Officer Dr. J. Keith Dunbar.

"Our partnership with FedLearn expands our public sector education initiatives, bringing our expertise in quantum information science to individuals across national security disciplines to help prepare them for success in the coming quantum era."
